lead: 一个人做的几件称手之物，覆盖 Mac、Windows 和乐奇 AI 眼镜。每一次发布，都记在这里。

products.name: KVMini
products.desc: 一套键盘鼠标控制 Mac 和 Windows 两台电脑。连上即用，复制的文字、图片、富文本和文件都能直接在另一台粘贴。全程 TLS 加密。
products.note: Windows 版即将提供；两台电脑请安装同一版本。
products.desc_en: One keyboard and mouse for your Mac and Windows computers. Connect and go — copied text, images, rich text and files paste straight onto the other computer. TLS encrypted end to end.
products.note_en: Windows version coming soon; please install the same version on both computers.

products.name: SnipScribe
products.desc: 菜单栏截屏识字：框选屏幕，文字直接进剪贴板，全程离线。

downloads.label: App Store · 中国区（名为 OneNoteCopy）

products.desc_en: Screenshot-to-text in the menu bar: select part of the screen and the text goes straight to your clipboard, fully offline.

products.name: MovieBox
products.desc: 本地优先的视频管理器：多目录扫描、隐私遮罩、加密保险箱、重复检测、人物归类。
products.desc_en: A local-first video manager: multi-folder scanning, privacy masking, an encrypted vault, duplicate detection and grouping by person.

products.name: 图谱 RokidChart
products.desc: 乐奇 Rokid AI 眼镜上的乐谱浏览器与提词器：镜腿翻页、自动滚动、节拍器、倒计时。
products.desc_en: A sheet music viewer and teleprompter for Rokid AI glasses: swipe the temple to turn pages, auto-scroll, metronome, countdown.

products.name: IDPhoto Studio
products.desc: macOS 证件照制作：内置 16 国规格，抠图、合规校验、打印排版全程本地处理，照片绝不上传。一次买断，不订阅。
products.note: 照片全程在本机处理，不联网、不上传；一次买断，不订阅。
products.desc_en: Make ID photos on your Mac: specs for 16 countries, background removal, compliance checks and print layout — all processed locally, photos never uploaded. One-time purchase, no subscription.
products.note_en: Everything is processed on your Mac — no network, no upload. One-time purchase, no subscription.

products.name: 生命树
products.desc: 50 题问卷测出你的四维健康树格（睡眠 / 饮食 / 运动 / 压力），每天打卡让生命树生长。健康数据只留在本机；开启同步后只同步昵称、营养包、挑战进度和文字记录。
products.note: 需要 iOS 17 或更高版本。App 中的「树的寿命」是虚拟生命树的游戏化数值，不预测任何人的寿命；健康建议不构成医疗诊断。
products.desc_en: A 50-question survey places you in one of 16 four-dimension health ArborTypes (sleep / diet / activity / stress); daily check-ins grow your life tree. Health data stays on your device; with sync on, only your nickname, packs, challenge progress and notes sync.
products.note_en: Requires iOS 17 or later. The "tree lifespan" is a game value for your virtual tree and predicts no one's lifespan; the health advice is not a medical diagnosis.

products.name: PromptLedger 提示词账本
products.desc: macOS 菜单栏 / Windows 托盘里的提示词账本：WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、Cursor 的轮次与 Token 消耗一屏看完——本月额度、今日轮次、最近 7 天柱状图、重复问题提醒，每周自动生成周报。数据全部留在本机。
products.desc_en: A prompt ledger in your macOS menu bar or Windows tray: turns and token usage across WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy and Cursor on one screen — monthly quota, today's turns, a 7-day bar chart, duplicate-question alerts, and a weekly report generated automatically. All data stays on your machine.
products.note: 源码在工蜂，发布包与自动更新清单在 GitHub；装好后会自己检查更新。手机端是网页版，配对后看同一份数据。
products.note_en: Source lives on an internal Git host; release builds and the update manifest are on GitHub, and the app checks for updates by itself. The mobile web app shows the same data once paired.

lead_en: A few well-made things by one person, for Mac, Windows and Rokid AI glasses. Every release is recorded here.
